title: DNS/FIPS operator UX rollup
intent: Document the completed DNS/FIPS operator experience as a Nostr-native workflow for human browser operators and MCP/agent operators, with PSTF evidence tied to the completed child Beads issues.
observed_behavior_before: DNS and FIPS operator surfaces were split across child feature artifacts. Older docs still described DNS operator request kinds as reserved-only and did not summarize the human and agent UX that now reads state from Nostr read models and writes DNS commands through signed Nostr control-plane events.
implemented_behavior: The rollup PSTF artifacts and operator docs describe the integrated UX: the web DNS dashboard reads DNS and FIPS mesh state from scoped Nostr read-model subscriptions, DNS actions publish signed 594x control-plane events and track OK/status/result events, MCP exposes DNS/FIPS discovery/action surfaces for agents, and REST remains a compatibility/query surface rather than the dashboard substrate or write path.
scope: Operator documentation near the DNS/FIPS docs and control-plane docs
Verification evidence from completed child Beads plus focused rollup checks
constraints: Docs/PSTF-only rollup; code changes are out of scope unless a serious inconsistency requires a tiny fix.
No fake claims: evidence cites concrete files, child PSTF reports, tests, and focused grep/status checks.
Remaining real gaps must be tracked in Beads rather than prose-only lists.
